evals.prompt: i fixed the thing where our retry logic kept firing after the request had already timed out, it was in src/http/retry.go, ticket is PLAT-1184. what should the commit message be
evals.expected_output: A single-line message: type fix, optional scope, ticket id right after the colon, imperative lower-case description, no body, no period.
assertions: The subject starts with `fix` and a colon, optionally with a scope in parentheses
PLAT-1184 appears in the subject, immediately after the colon
The description is lower case, imperative, and has no trailing period
The subject is 72 characters or fewer
No body is produced, because the subject carries the change

evals.prompt: we're changing the pagination API so callers pass a cursor instead of an offset. offset is gone entirely. write me the commit message
evals.expected_output: A breaking change marked both with ! before the colon and with a BREAKING CHANGE footer naming what breaks.
assertions: The subject carries `!` immediately before the colon
A `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer is present, uppercase, after a blank line
The footer states what a caller must change, not only that something changed

evals.prompt: here's my commit message, does it follow our convention? 'Updated the parser and also fixed a bug in the tokenizer. Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>'
evals.expected_output: A rejection naming each violation and a corrected version split into two commits.
assertions: The past tense `Updated` is identified as a violation
The attribution line is identified as banned
The message is identified as covering two types of change, so two commits
A corrected subject is offered for each of the two commits
The missing type prefix is identified
